description: One of Apotheosis's rarities with fields replaced. A rarity cannot be switched off: Apotheosis needs all five.

disabled.description: true switches the entry off: Apotheosis skips it, as if it did not exist (neoforge:never).
disabled.title: Disabled

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

rarity.description: The rarity it changes, e.g. apotheosis:rare.
rarity.title: Rarity

replace.description: Top-level fields of the entry, each replaced as a whole, in Apotheosis's own format, e.g. categories: [apotheosis:bow]. Every field must exist in the entry and keep its JSON type.
replace.title: Replace

title: ApotheosisRarityDef
